description: This file defines a React component for a Sessions dashboard page, including data fetching, filtering, chart visualization, and a data table with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: distinctSorted
methods.description: Helper function to get a sorted list of unique, non-empty string values from an array.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Converts snake_case keys to human-readable labels.

methods.name: buildRestrictedColumns
methods.description: Builds DataTable column definitions based on allowed fields, with custom render logic.

methods.name: loadAggregates
methods.description: Fetches session data across multiple pages to generate aggregate data for charts and dropdown options.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches session data from server with pagination, filtering, and sorting.
